preparation.preservation_reference: prepared_sha256; exact edit checks do not compare against uploaded original
preparation.notice: Preparation changes picture and audio. Keep the uploaded original. No edit is approved by preparation.

candidate.reference_selection: Observed frame in the originally kept appearance class, selected with the reviewed cut points to minimize predicted boundary RMS. No blended or invented pixels.
candidate.meaning: Keep the more contrasting observed state steady during this interval; review both states. This may be instructional content.

policy.selection: Minimize worst predicted boundary RGB RMS, then sum, then maximize held duration. Observed references stay in the originally kept appearance class. Trim only; never extend the detected interval. Preserve first and last clip frames.

boundary_alignment.scope: Predicted selected-box RGB and selected-mean changes. Encoded selected/influence RGB and linear-mean checks independently decide acceptance.

acceptance.meaning: Encoded preservation and activity measurements only. Creator review is required; no measured learning or accessibility benefit.

proposal.reference_selection: Observed frame in the originally kept appearance class, selected with the reviewed cut points to minimize predicted boundary RMS. No blended or invented pixels.
proposal.meaning: Keep the more contrasting observed state steady during this interval; review both states. This may be instructional content.

policy.selection: Minimize worst predicted boundary RGB RMS, then sum, then maximize held duration. Observed references stay in the originally kept appearance class. Trim only; never extend the detected interval. Preserve first and last clip frames.

boundary_alignment.scope: Predicted selected-box RGB and selected-mean changes. Encoded selected/influence RGB and linear-mean checks independently decide acceptance.

stationary_detail.metric: Number of adjacent ROI-mean RGB changes >=8 codes. Interior and fixed whole-clip counts are separate; the latter includes both cut boundaries.

policy.selection: Minimize worst predicted boundary RGB RMS, then sum, then maximize held duration. Observed references stay in the originally kept appearance class. Trim only; never extend the detected interval. Preserve first and last clip frames.

encoded_boundary_checks.scope: Entry, return and clip-loop boundary; selected and influence boxes; mean absolute, RMS and maximum decoded RGB differences must each be no greater than source (1e-12 floating comparison tolerance, no perceptual budget). This is not a safety or human-benefit measure.

protected_content.scope: Every decoded RGB frame versus prepared source. Fixed areas; creator judges meaning and readability.

teaching_motion.meaning: Decoded sample changes, including codec variation; not semantic progress ticks, legibility or learning measurements. Source and edited teaching regions are compared at their original frame times.

summary.codec: Lossless H.264 High 4:4:4 Predictive, YUV420; verify browser playback separately
warnings: Holds observed brightness samples only during the shown interval and keeps every original color sample on its timeline. Small color variation inside the box may remain; alternate brightness phases are intentionally removed.
A blinking detail may convey progress or position. Check both source states and the boundaries before using this edit.
Native samples and decoded RGB outside the selected box, plus all original chroma samples, must remain exact. The older four-pixel influence check also remains.
Preparation resized/re-encoded the original. Exact edit checks reference the prepared clip.
No learning, time-saving, medical, safety or compliance claim.

acceptance.meaning: Encoded preservation and activity measurements only. Creator review is required; no measured learning or accessibility benefit.

policy.selection: Minimize worst predicted boundary RGB RMS, then sum, then maximize held duration. Observed references stay in the originally kept appearance class. Trim only; never extend the detected interval. Preserve first and last clip frames.

encoded_boundary_checks.scope: Entry, return and clip-loop boundary; selected and influence boxes; mean absolute, RMS and maximum decoded RGB differences must each be no greater than source (1e-12 floating comparison tolerance, no perceptual budget). This is not a safety or human-benefit measure.

teaching_motion.meaning: Decoded sample changes, including codec variation; not semantic progress ticks, legibility or learning measurements. Source and edited teaching regions are compared at their original frame times.

decision.interpretation: Creator approved one bounded edit; read the encoded report for its measurements.
decision.detector_scope: Frozen rapid-change detector: at least 7 alternating luminance transitions in a rolling second, connected support at least 64 pixels. Separate steady-detail-v1: small stationary two-state luma appearance, at least 6 transitions, bounded state/chroma errors and dwell. A reviewed hold is trimmed to matched cut points, at least 60 frames and four internal changes; first/last clip frames remain unchanged. Encoded selected/influence boundary RGB and selected-mean changes cannot worsen. Proposals are not semantic distraction labels.
limitations: No candidate does not mean distraction-free or safe.
Ordinary caret blinking, notifications and camera movement may be outside this detector.
Preparation changes picture/audio and may make small teaching labels unreadable.
Exact edit measurements reference the prepared clip, not the uploaded original.
This record does not establish learning benefit or accessibility compliance.
